title: Same Data, Different Answers: Robust Omics Data Analysis from Reads to Biology (MOOC materials)
description: Materials, scripts and cloud environment of a MOOC on omics data analysis built on the computer practicals of Systems Molecular Biology (University of Córdoba): genome assembly, RNA-seq, label-free and TMT proteomics, functional enrichment and multi-omics integration, with a re-analysis of Dupuis, Ojeda et al. 2025 (The Plant Cell). Every step compares alternative pipelines and measures how much each choice changes the result.
